item.title: 6 families displaced following Anniston apartment fire
item.description: Authorities arrived on the scene of a fire at an apartment complex that displace six families Monday.

item.title: Fairfield City Council announces baseball partnership
item.description: The Fairfield City Council announced Monday a new partnership to help encourage area children to play baseball.

item.title: 2 killed, 3 injured in Rhode Island ice rink shooting
item.description: Three people are dead, including the suspect, and three others are in critical condition after a shooting at a Rhode Island ice skating rink Monday afternoon.

item.title: City of Jasper joins Live Locally Alabama campaign
item.description: The city of Jasper is joining a campaign aimed at highlighting the importance of supporting local communities and showcasing quality of life across Alabama.

item.title: Durbin Farms owner discusses peach crop outlook
item.description: As peach season grows closer, it raises the question of what the crop outlook will be given the back-and-forth temperatures central Alabama has seen.

item.title: Alabama bill proposes changing school report card ratings
item.description: Public schools around Alabama receive report cards every year just like students. One lawmaker said it is time for a change when it comes to rating how schools are performing.

item.title: 1 officer killed, 2nd injured in shooting near Indiana high school; suspect apprehended
item.description: One police officer was killed and another was injured in a shooting in Beech Grove, Indiana on Monday. The suspect was taken into custody Monday evening, according to the Indianapolis Metropolitan Police Department.

item.title: Police chief reacts to 3 Alabama police officers shot in 1 week
item.description: Three police officers in Alabama were shot last week. All of them are expected to survive.

item.title: George Barber Jr. dies
item.description: George Barber Jr., who established Barber Motorsports Park, has died.
